Normalises any thrown error into an ApiFailure with a status, validation errors, and request info. Non-HTTP errors become status 0. Called by many view models across about, auth, contact, meetings, updates, youtube, and settings features to show error messages.

Shared helper that performs an axios GET on a path with optional config and returns only the response body typed as T. Used by the endpoint clients, though the grep shows no direct callers in this set.

Registers a listener that is called for every failed HTTP request, excluding cancelled ones, typically for analytics logging. Returns a function that removes the listener. Used by createTracker in the analytics feature.

Generic HTTP POST helper that sends a body through the shared axios instance and returns just the response data, typed by the caller. Used as the base for write calls from the frontend services layer.

Sets a preview mode for outgoing GET requests: 'loading' holds them until cancelled, 'error' fails them with a 500. Writes and sign-in are never affected. Called by the preview feature and releases any held requests when the mode changes.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/api/a.text: RTK Query endpoints for the About Me page: load and replace the page content, fetch LeetCode stats for the saved username, and search cities for the Where I've been list. Updating the page also invalidates LeetCode data, since the username may have changed.

RTK Query endpoints for the Engagement analytics tab: period summary, paginated visit list (optionally errors only), single visit details, and visit deletion. Deleting a visit refreshes the summary and visit list. Visit recording is handled elsewhere, in the analytics feature.

RTK Query endpoints for apps, app categories, and YouTube data: list, create/update/delete apps, admin ordering, category management, channel info, video listing and refresh, and a combined 'What's new' latest item. Saving the order also updates the cached order immediately. Many mutations invalidate the apps list so the Apps page and What's new stay current.
Hook that prefetches the next page of apps for the Apps grid, skipping it if already loaded and fresh. Used only by the Apps page.
Hook that prefetches the next page of YouTube videos for the video grid, skipping it if already loaded and fresh. Used only by the YouTube page.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/api/c.text: RTK Query endpoints for supporter and subscriber features: Buy me a coffee info and donations list, email subscription (subscribe, confirm, unsubscribe), subscriber management, announcement review (send or ignore), and editing, previewing, testing, and resetting update email wording. Consumed by the support, updates, and site-visibility view models.

RTK Query endpoints for the contact form and admin inbox: send a message, list and fetch messages, mark read, delete, and reply. Marking read and replying patch cached data in place so the inbox and open conversation update without a refetch. Older API responses missing replies or meetings get empty defaults.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/api/m.text: RTK Query endpoints for Cal.com meetings: fetch the admin's booking link, list meetings for a date range for the calendar, and accept, decline, or cancel a meeting. Decisions update the matching meeting status wherever it appears. Used by the contact replies view and the meetings calendar.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/api/n.text: RTK Query endpoints for the admin's Notifications tab: lists and saves alert kinds and alert channels (ntfy, site notifications) with optimistic toggles, manages push devices, and loads the notification history. Feeds three notification view models.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/api/r.text: RTK Query endpoints for the résumé generator: reads and saves contact header and choices, generates the PDFs, and fetches the public headline shown on About Me. Generating invalidates the About cache.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/api/s.text: RTK Query endpoints behind Settings → Signed-in devices: lists the admin's sessions, ends one session, or ends all other sessions. Each change reloads the list.

RTK Query endpoints for the Settings tab: loads all service settings, saves a single key/value (empty clears it), and tests a connected service. Saves write the API's returned settings back into the cache.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/api/t.text: RTK Query endpoints for the site's terms and conditions: loads the document once and keeps it cached for the whole session, and updates it after an admin save so visitors are asked again. Used by the popup, gate, and Terms tab.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/api/w.text: RTK Query endpoints for the Work with me hourly price: anyone can read it, and the admin can save a new value. The cache is replaced with the price the API stored.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/authS.text: Redux slice holding the admin's auth state (loading, signed in, or anonymous). It updates from session check, refresh, and sign-out results, and drops to anonymous when another tab signs out.

Async thunk run on page open that calls the auth API's me endpoint, retrying with backoff on network errors. It only settles on the API's answer (signed in or 401), so an API outage does not sign the admin out.
Async thunk that re-checks the session via the auth API's me endpoint on activity or when the session should have expired. A network error leaves the current auth state unchanged.
Returns the timestamp of the most recent session check made by checkSession or refreshSession. Used by useSessionKeeper to decide when to refresh.
Signs out only the current device by calling the auth logout API; other devices stay signed in. Used by useAuth, the auth slice, and the store listeners.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/baseA.text: The RTK Query API slice that caches server data in the Redux store under 'serverData' and refetches by tag after saves. Feature endpoints are injected into it from store/api/.
Wraps an API service call so it returns RTK Query's shape: data on success, or a serializable ApiFailure on error. Most feature endpoint files use it.
Runs a callback with the response data only when an onQueryStarted request succeeds, and ignores failures. Several feature endpoint files use it to update state after a save.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/index.text: Builds the Redux store from the server data API, the auth, site, terms, theme and preview slices, and the listener middleware. Called by render.tsx and main.tsx, and used by AppStore in meetings.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/liste.text: Middleware for side effects of state changes: saving terms, theme and site settings, storing the preview mode, signing out, and syncing other tabs. It is the only place these effects happen.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/loada.text: Returns how many pages a paged list has for a total item count and page size, never fewer than one. Used by usePagedQuery.
Converts an RTK Query result into a loading, error, or loaded state for views. Errors show until a retry starts, and existing data stays visible during refreshes. Used by many view models.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/previ.text: Selector that returns the admin's preview mode only when the user is signed in and in development, otherwise normal. Used by the app layout view model and the listeners.
Redux slice holding the admin's preview mode, loaded from storage at startup, with one action to change it. Used by the preview switch view model and the store.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/siteS.text: Redux thunk that loads the site's status from the API. Any failure, including a 4xx, is reported as a status code so visitors see an unreachable state rather than a broken site.
Admin-only thunk that sends site setting changes to the API and returns what the server stored, so the UI reflects the saved result.
Redux slice holding site state (loaded or unreachable). Loaded data comes from fetchSite or saveSite; cancelled fetches leave state unchanged.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/terms.text: Redux slice tracking whether the terms dialog is open and which terms version the visitor accepted, with the initial accepted version read from storage.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/theme.text: Thunk called when the Vice scene draws too slowly. If the visitor hasn't picked a theme, it switches to their system light or dark theme and remembers the device as slow.
Redux slice for the active theme. Tracks visitor-chosen themes separately from automatic slow-scene switches, which the visitor can dismiss without them counting as a choice.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/store/usePa.text: Hook that fetches one page of a list and computes the total page count. If the requested page is past the end, it moves to the last page; it exposes a retry function.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/utils/forma.text: Converts an ISO 8601 timestamp from the API into a locale-aware date string, such as 'Oct 8, 2026', for display.
Converts an ISO 8601 timestamp from the API into a locale- and time-zone-aware date and time string for display in the viewer's browser.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/utils/linki.text: Splits plain text into segments, marking each URL with an href so the UI can render clickable links. Used by LinkifiedText in the YouTube feature.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/utils/motio.text: Returns true unless the visitor's system requests reduced motion. Used by the paged grid, media carousel, and page transition view models to decide whether to animate.

frontend:symbol:frontend/src/utils/saveE.text: Extracts per-field validation messages from a failed save, keeping the first message for each field, or returns null if the failure was not a validation error. Used by the app, categories, organise, and update-emails dialog view models.
Returns a user-facing message for a failed save that isn't a field validation error: a sign-in prompt on 401, otherwise a generic retry message. Used by the same four dialog view models.

tier:backend.text: An ASP.NET Core minimal API with one folder per feature: each maps its endpoints, validates with a *Rules class and reads or writes its own EF Core entities. Background workers send alerts, update emails and meeting reminders, and refresh YouTube videos. Secrets saved in the Settings tab are encrypted and override the configuration; the admin is identified by a session cookie backed by the admin_sessions table.

tier:database.text: PostgreSQL, generated from the EF Core model: a table or two per feature. Editable pages (About Me, terms, update emails) are single JSON documents; outside data (LeetCode stats, YouTube videos) is cached as snapshots that survive restarts; contact messages, meetings, subscribers, visits and alerts are ordinary rows.

tier:frontend.text: The Frontend tier is the public site and admin console, built as feature modules. Visitors get About Me, Apps, YouTube, Contact, Updates, Terms and Support, while the admin also gets Settings, Notifications, Analytics, Meetings and Feature Testing. Shared UI and base API code sit underneath, and Auth and Site decide which pages and tabs each user sees. Each feature calls its own backend API, and uploads go through the files API. Auth state lives in Redux, and consent and theme choices stay in browser localStorage.
